articleTitle: How to Fit Strength Training & Meal Prep Into 60+ Hour Weeks
imageHeadline: Strength training on a 60-hour work week? It's possible.
imageSubtext: Evidence-based strategies that actually fit your schedule.
pinTitle: How to Fit Strength Training & Meal Prep Into 60+ Hour Weeks | Realistic Fitness Tips
pinDescription: Working long hours doesn't mean giving up on strength training or nutrition. Learn how to structure workouts and meal prep around demanding schedules—whether you're managing work, school, or health conditions—without adding to your stress. Find practical, evidence-based strategies for staying consistent when time is tight.
